ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels with a secondary low-intensity black border; estimated macro-ratio of 4:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Vast central high-intensity region. Continuous low-intensity black border along the trailing edge and distal tips. Discrete low-intensity focal point on the left lobe and clusters around the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped notch; internal angle approximately 115 degrees; vertical depth relative to lobe tips is moderate.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations along the continuous trailing boundary; average amplitude of 3-7 pixels from the mean edge curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a smooth concave curvature directed toward the central notch from the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark, circular pixel aggregations along the trailing edge interface, most concentrated on the medial portion of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct, vertically-oriented low-intensity linear feature on the left lobe, approximately mid-way between the notch and the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical dark scar on the left fluke lobe. Irregular pigmentation and potential scarring at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel occlusion in the lower central region due to water splash and spray.
